annotations.title: ABI-encode values (or full calldata for a function signature)

description: ABI-encode values (or full calldata for a function signature). Encodes values per the Solidity ABI: all integer sizes (range-checked), address, bool, bytesN, bytes, string, fixed and dynamic arrays and tuples (nested). With a function signature, returns calldata with the selector. Integers may be decimal or 0x strings. Price: $0.003 USDC per call via x402 (eip155:8453).

values.description: Values in order; tuples as arrays
